data.long_meaning: The Sanskrit word ‘Khushi’ means ‘joy’, ‘happiness’, or ‘contentment’. It is derived from the root word ‘Khus’ which means ‘content’ or ‘satisfied’. In Hindu mythology, Khushi is personified as a goddess of happiness, joy, and pleasure. The name Khushi carries the meaning “Joy, Happiness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Khushi usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, happiness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
